title: Emerald View | KEY.co
description_expanded: I cannot say enough about my families experience at Inlet Beach. This was our second time coming. We previously stayed in the house next door and thought we hit the jackpot there. Never did we realize how much we needed a home as strategically planned as 79 Emerald Cove Lane. There were 14 of us from 1.5 years to 90 years old. Everyone had exactly what they needed to "vacation their own way". There were quiet spaces, communal spaces and relaxing spaces. Laundry on every floor, full stocked kitchen(s) and pantry. There was nothing that you needed other than your food, your bathing suit and a beverage! The views were spectacular, especially for my 90 year old mother who could still see the beach and smell the salty air from a number of decks. The pool provided late evening fun and kept the party going. We are already coordinating our calendars to return. This is our new \"beach home\". What a beautiful and blessed experience.

Features: Outdoor Heated pool Pool Outdoor kitchen
